BETTER SMART CARE: Simply use the free VeSync APP to control settings anytime & anywhere, create schedules, etc. And the Auto Mode will maintain the room humidity at the healthiest humidity level in you

PLANTS NEED IT: In addition to the most basic plant humidification, it offers you more comprehensive plant-care programs. Including scanning recognition, more professional encyclopedias, and specialized custom plant management

TROUBLESHOOTING：
The display shows the No Water Indicator incorrectly:
1. Please ensure the arrow above the LED display is aligned with the indicator line on the base to ensure the water tank is properly on the base.
2. Check the max water line to see if there is too much water in the tank and base chamber. Pour out extra water if water is over the max line.
3. Check and clean the Water Outlet Valve.
4. Check whether the Float Brackets rotate smoothly and clean them.
WATER FILTER REPLACEMENT: Please search B09ZY9N6PD or Levoit humidifier replacement filter which can extend the life of your humidifier aroma pads
REPLACEMENT:  Please search B0B8MD45FB or Levoit aroma pads for more information which can help emit a more potent fragrance and protect the fragrance box
